Sensa Signal Issue 07 · Jul 2026
Rendering Imagination

Real time just caught up to photoreal, on site not in post

SIGGRAPH 2026 wrapped in Los Angeles (July 19 to 23). The headlines went to film VFX. The story for experiential producers is quieter and bigger: the render farm is moving on site.

01 Field notes

Neural rendering left the lab

NVIDIA's keynote on July 20, Next Era of Graphics, put neural rendering, world models and AI driven simulation on the near term roadmap, not the research horizon. Photoreal environments that used to be a post production line item are becoming something you generate and change live.

See what shifts ›
02
In the lab

A GPU built for real time path tracing

Bolt Graphics used SIGGRAPH on July 21 to show Zeus, a GPU architecture aimed squarely at real time path tracing. Path tracing is what makes light look honest, and doing it live is what an LED wall or a projection surface has always been missing.

Read the read ›
03 Craft

Generative 3D compressed the asset timeline

Generative 3D tooling, with Tripo AI among the names on stage, keeps shrinking the distance between an idea and a usable asset. For a two week activation build, that is the difference between one hero moment and a whole responsive world.

Think in worlds ›
Watch · one take, no cuts

Sixty seconds of real time, no render wait

The through line from the show floor: light that used to bake overnight now moves live. Watch before your next brief.
